response_parity: Two added negative fixtures exposed optional defaults accepting explicit null although the frozen schema forbids it. ModelMappingOptions now validates the whole explicitly supplied projection against the existing frozen schema. No schema rule was relaxed; final total 519 fixtures and 2322 Python checks.

Corrected the field and exact four business audit counts. Compatibility fixture first randomly selected a Chromium-restricted port; a follow-up unbounded retry of the OS ephemeral range was interrupted before database/process creation, then replaced by at most 60 explicit randomly chosen high-port bind attempts. The legacy Workflow fixture also lacked the current channel-detail GET projection, expected an obsolete approval label, and intercepted the current read-only statistics/session activity routes. It now handles the safe projection and lets real statistics/session activity run; no runtime error is ignored. Private browser fixtures allocate ports above 20000 without disabling browser port protection. Failed runs closed their owned contexts/processes/databases and preserved reports.
